latest_release.name: Happy CLI v1.2.5
latest_release.body:
## Happy CLI 1.2.5

### Session reliability
- Preserve and recover resumable sessions after daemon state is lost.
- Prevent duplicate owners during concurrent or cancelled resumes.
- Recover transcripts that appear late or after watcher restart.
- Keep closed sessions closed.

### Codex and Claude
- Remove the Codex turn timeout and preserve valid turn IDs for continued output and diffs.
- Improve expired Claude login diagnostics.
- Forward configured Claude plugin directories.

### macOS
- Avoid reconnecting during dark wake while retaining compatibility fallbacks.

### Shared runtime behavior
- Include message acceptance, queue metadata, and synchronized composer draft support.

detail.readme:
Happy Engineering

The fun way of making things :D

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/deeeeaf5-e550-49bc-829f-1186898f441a

   

## What you get 1. **Any model: Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini, and more.** Gemini runs through Antigravity, and OpenCode or any Agent Client Protocol agent plugs in as a harness. Give every task the model that fits, and delegate to subagents on any of them. 2. **Reuse your subscriptions.** Sign in with the Claude, Codex, and Grok subscriptions you already pay for; Antigravity, OpenCode, and ACP agents keep their own logins. Happy adds a harness, not another bill. 3. **Open source MIT.** It runs on your own hardware and your projects stay ordinary folders. Read the code, fork it, ship your own build. 4. **End-to-end encrypted mobile app.** Left your desk? The same sessions are already on your phone, and what moves between your devices is encrypted. 5. **Natively multiplayer.** Invite a colleague or a friend into the session. You both watch the same agent work, and either of you can steer it. #### Resources

Website · Documentation · Discord · Development guide · MIT License

## How Happy fits together | Repository | What it is | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | **[slopus/happy](https://github.com/slopus/happy)** ← this repository | **The mobile app (iOS, Android, web), the original CLI, and the relay server** | | [slopus/happy-desktop](https://github.com/slopus/happy-desktop) | The desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux | | [slopus/happy-agent](https://github.com/slopus/happy-agent) | Happy Agent, the open-source agent runtime the desktop app runs on | | [slopus/slopus.github.io](https://github.com/slopus/slopus.github.io) | The website and docs at happy.engineering | ## Original Happy CLI The original CLI wraps the Claude Code and Codex harnesses directly in your terminal and lets you continue from your phone. For multi-model sessions and teams, move to the desktop app and Happy Harness. ```sh npm install -g happy # Start Claude Code happy claude # Or start Codex happy codex ``` - [happy-ios](packages/happy-ios): native Swift/UIKit iOS app - [happy-android](packages/happy-android): native Kotlin/Jetpack Compose Android app - [happy-i18n](packages/happy-i18n): shared JSON translations - [happy-cli](packages/happy-cli): the original Happy CLI (`happy` on npm) - [happy-server](packages/happy-server): the relay server for encrypted sync - [happy-push-server](packages/happy-push-server): Cloudflare Worker that delivers push notifications via APNs/FCM (replaces the Expo push service) Migrated from the `happy-coder` package. Thanks to [@franciscop](https://github.com/franciscop) for donating the `happy` package name!
